reason: The first order is cash on delivery and Abu Ali's name is on the receipt, so I can test one small batch of kids' items with nothing at risk. But at 13,000 a kilo by air, my landed cost per piece is too high to resell at Shorja prices, so I would only continue if the trader rate and slow cargo work out cheaper.
objection: I've waited weeks before. Refunding only the buying fee if it's late doesn't cover a shop that promised stock to customers, and air shipping per kilo eats my margin on cheap goods.
would_change_my_mind: A written per-kilo price for the slow cargo and trader rate, with a firm delivery date, that brings my landed cost per piece below what I pay in Shorja.
